name: Progress M-22
about: Progress M-22 (1994-019A), a crewed vehicle (Progress M), launched 1994 Mar 22. One orbit from GCAT's satcat (shape and inclination; orientation estimated), then how that phase ended (DK).

pieces.why: GCAT gives the orbit's shape and inclination, not its orientation or where along it the craft was; the orbit is GCAT's at its epoch (1994 Apr 21), held fixed
docked to S17845; GCAT's tables give no later phase (undocking, landing)
